integrity: The proof is universal and exhausts every integer form allowed by \(\Omega(n),\Omega(n+1)\le2\). The attached computation is corroborative only and is not used to infer the unbounded claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only the exact first multiplicity barrier for consecutive equal \(\beta\)-values. It does not settle whether infinitely many solutions exist, nor classify solutions once at least one of \(n,n+1\) has three or more prime factors counted with multiplicity.
title: A sharp two-almost-prime barrier for equal consecutive alternating divisor sums
